nom: Paula's Choice SKIN PERFECTING 8% AHA Gel Exfoliant

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin generally found it effective as part of their routine, with one suggesting it may be enough without a separate moisturizer if your skin runs oily.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin found the gel effective but still needed to follow with a moisturizer.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination-oily skin, including one dealing with cystic acne and hyperpigmentation, report significant clearing of breakouts and lightening of dark spots after weeks of consistent use.
segments.sensitive: Reports split sharply: several reviewers with sensitive or redness-prone skin experienced burning, redness or light burns on the face and had to stop or move it to body use only, while others with sensitive (including sensitive, acne-prone) skin report no irritation at all and significant improvement.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report the gel smoothed the visible texture of fine lines and made skin look firmer and brighter after consistent nightly use over several weeks; one notes it does not remove established wrinkles, only softens their visibility.
concerns.dehydration: Reports conflict: several reviewers say it does not dry out skin or cause peeling when used as directed, while others describe it as quite drying, requiring a moisturizer, or in a couple of cases causing redness, peeling or a crusty, burning feeling.
concerns.redness: This is the concern with the most negative reports: several reviewers describe burning and visible redness, in some cases light burns, especially on the face and with daily use; other reviewers report no such reaction and describe calm, clear skin instead, so tolerance appears to vary significantly by individual.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report lightening of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, acne scars and sunspots after several weeks to a couple of months of consistent use, including on hands as well as the face.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with cystic acne or long-standing breakouts, report significant clearing after one to four months of consistent use, with a couple noting a temporary "purging" phase of surfacing pimples early on that then resolves; no reviewer reports the product itself worsening breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Small travel-size bottle disappoints for the price
Cap or lid often arrives loose or leaking
Clear gel spreads easily, a little goes a long way
Bottle lasts a long time despite small size

extraits.texte: The bottle is tiny . I used it once and it started to burn my skin . My face is a horrible shade of red right now.. I wasted ten bucks on this ...

...but ok for bodies. My skin has the distinct honor of being both acne-prone and sensitive, and I’ve struggled to find products that can treat and prevent acne while not damaging my face. Unfortunately, this is not one of them. The marks on my face in the pictures are light burns from this product (applied once a day for the last ~3 weeks). While I can’t recommend this product for use on the face, I do think it‘s safe and effective to use on the body. I’ve also been using it on a rough patch on my big toe. The top photo was taken on Nov. 3; the bottom on Nov. 15. Buyer beware 🤷🏾‍♀️

extraits.titre: Prefer BHA over AHA for redness prone skin
extraits.texte: Had to update this review. If you ordered this in November as I did, the ingredients included parabens which was surprising to me. After speaking to a Paula's Choice rep, I was told that ingredients in this gel have been modified within the past month or so to exclude parabens, which is great. That aside, I felt that this was too strong for my skin--using it once a day made my skin pretty red and dry. Maybe my skin would have adjusted, but my skin is already a bit to red to begin with so I thought I'd go a different route. I've been much happier with Paula's Choice BHA treatment, alternating it with the 1% retinol at night.

extraits.titre: Cured my cystic acne and congested skin
extraits.texte: I have sensitive, acne prone, combination skin. I started breaking out at 24 and it was on and off. Then, two years ago, I started breaking out to the point where family and friends would ask what was going on. There was no part of my face that did not have acne or congested pores. It was embarassing and painful! Well, let me tell you — this stuff got rid of all my skin problems! I had a mixture of milia, regular acne, and cystic acne on my face. I was using 16% glycolic acid, which only led to angry breakouts. Once I switched over to this, I started seeing fantastic results. Warning: clogged pores or burgeoning pimples will come to the surface or “purge.” However, you will know if something is not working for you if you start breaking out in angry and inflamed acne (especially in areas you don’t usually break out in). This was thankfully not the case for me. It took about four months for my skin to completely clear. It even cleared up stubborn spots that other products were ineffective in. My skin is very sensitive and this has not irritated it. One tiny drop is enough to spread on my entire face. I noticed that it stings a bit and can be drying when I use more than usual. I am so thankful I found this product! I had a baby two months ago and my skin has remained clear postpartum. This was not the case with my first two babies! Even when I’m tired and fatigued, my skin still has a fresh glow from the product. I haven’t had a “glow” since my early 20s. I am now 31. Please try

extraits.titre: Very good product, will buy again.
extraits.texte: Bought this product about two months ago and my skin is looking the best it has in years. Would absolutely recommend. Below are my personal pros and cons for this product: Pros: - It works well! My skin is the clearest it's been my entire adult life. Not only has all the acne cleared, but I rarely if ever break out anymore and my acne scars are slowly becoming less noticable. - A little goes a long way. You don't even need a full pump to give enough product to cover your whole face. This helps to offset the fact that it's slightly pricey. Cons: - while it does work very well, it takes time to work. It was about 2 months if consistent use before I got the results I'm enjoying now, and the slow progress can be discouraging. - it is somewhat pricey (but like I said, a little goes a long way) - it has a mild but unpleasant odor - it is very drying, so you MUST use a moisturizer - it makes your face light sensitive, so you MUST use sunscreen. Get yourself a good moisturizer with SPF 30+ to protect your face while using this product. Seriously your face will get sunburnt super easily while consistently using this product, so you have to wear sunscreen. Overall, this is a great product that I would highly recommend. However, if you use it, a moisturizer with a sunscreen is a must. You'll also want to up your water intake, because hydrating helps combat the drying of your skin as well as decreasing acne.

extraits.titre: So far this is a stone winner!!!
extraits.texte: My complexion has not been so kind to me as of late and it's been really frustrating. I have darker skin so I deal with hyper-pigmentation from sporadic breakouts and with having combination/oily skin it's tough to find the right mix of products that make a difference. For some reason my skin has become really dull as well. With that I decided to dramatically change up my regular skin care routine in the hopes that I can get my fresh face back. My two constant problem areas are my neck & under my chin as well as the random breakouts & resulting dark spots. I have always tended to stuck to one product line but I've found a few items from a few different lines that have worked and have created 4 different routines. With the addition of Paula's Choice, my routine has kicked into high gear. The nightly use of this product has made a HUGE difference in the week I've used it. I have a morning and evening routine which alternates between acne, cleansing, exfoliating & moisturizing series of products. The one constant each night has been Paula's Choice Skin Perfecting Gel. I used this product at night after using my facewash (rotating between Kiehl's/Dermalogica/ProActive) & toner (Mario Badescu) and I have had no adverse reactions. My skin tone has improved, my spots seem to be getting lighter and my face is looking healthy, brighter and more firm again. I've tried peels, wipes, dermabrasion, exfoliators on top of Clarisonic. The darker parts hadn't budged or my skin would react but

I have been using it for 1 month so far, EVERY morning & evening. It spreads very well & little needs to be used, so it will last a long time! I was skeptical but went off the reviews. I started noticing a difference after a couple of weeks using it twice a day. It removes a very small layer of skin, which isn't noticeable but builds up over time creating a smoother appearance. I exfoliate every few days & each time my skin looks better and better and better I generally don't trust products to do get 'magical results' but I LOVE this product & will definitely buy more when I run out (which won't be any time soon!) I have less acne, fine lines are greatly improved (even after 1 month) & my skin is less rough, has a much smoother appearance & it has even started to improve sunspots too!
